title: cas12a-xai: Biophysically-Guided Explainable Machine Learning for CRISPR-Cas12a Cleavage Efficiency

creators.name: Tran, Minh
creators.affiliation: Independent Researcher, Perth, Western Australia, Australia

description: cas12a-xai is an open-source, biophysically-grounded explainable machine learning framework and design toolkit for predicting and mechanistically interpreting CRISPR-Cas12a guide RNA on-target cleavage efficiency.
